title: Playback-info panel field contract — one row list, every client shows the same rows with the same labels and units

modes.mini: Compact: player display size, stream frame, player state and device buffer.
modes.standard: Overview: player-reported picture beside original, delivery explanation, tracks and buffer.
modes.details: Grouped picture and sound, buffer and delivery, and server work with inline explanations.
modes.debug: Diagnostics: all available observations grouped by purpose, with inline notes.

formats.bitrate: "12.3 Mb/s" — one decimal below 10 Mb/s, none at or above; "800 kb/s" below 1 Mb/s. Unit is always Mb/s or kb/s, never Mbps.
formats.position: "<clock> / <clock>" — slash, never "of"; a playback rate other than 1 is appended as " · 1.5×".
formats.text: free text as the server or player reports it.
formats.list: items joined with " · " — the same joiner in every mode.

health_pill.meaning: server session state — Direct · Active · Held · VOD · Filling · Complete · Failed
health_pill.notes: Apple's pill counts player stalls today; that datum becomes the `stalls` row. One pill, one meaning.

unavailable_rendering: Player display size and Stream frame are always visible. Missing measurements read Unavailable; a known height alone reads Height <n>. Never substitute source or presentation dimensions for a stream frame. Persisted mini/standard/debug values remain compatible; details is additive.

fields.label: Method
fields.note: The delivery verdict — the same vocabulary on every client: Direct play · Remux · Transcode · Transcode · cached; the encoder and rung follow as a clause ("Transcode · nvenc · 1080p").

fields.label: Playback mode
fields.note: Live HLS / VOD HLS / progressive — the web presentation kind. Native players have one presentation.

fields.label: Reason
fields.note: Why the server chose this method.

fields.label: Switched
fields.note: Auto-quality moves this session.

fields.label: Original video
fields.note: codec · profile · bit depth · HDR format.

fields.label: Source audio track
fields.note: codec · channels · language, "+N tracks" when more exist.

fields.label: AV offset
fields.note: Applied offset; the container-declared value follows in parentheses when it differs.

fields.label: Player display size
fields.note: Presentation dimensions reported by the attached player; not encoded frame dimensions.

fields.label: Stream frame
fields.note: Encoded output plan or eligible attached stream sample, with provenance shown beside the value.

fields.label: Stream format
fields.note: Codec, scan and cadence only. Stream frame is the sole active output dimension row.

fields.label: Device audio output
fields.note: Speaker or HDMI output only when reported by the platform; never inferred from the audio track.

fields.label: Dynamic range
fields.note: Mini shows the chip form ("DV P7 → HDR10"); the ledger shows the sentence.

fields.label: Stream audio track
fields.note: Selected stream audio track metadata; not a claim about speaker or HDMI output.

fields.label: Frames
fields.note: dropped / total. AVPlayer does not expose it.

fields.label: Player state
fields.note: One vocabulary: Playing · Paused · Buffering · Ended · Failed.

fields.label: Decoder
fields.note: hardware / software, with the reason when software.

fields.label: Buffering interruptions
fields.note: "2 (1 supply · 1 decode)" — player-side stall count this session.

fields.label: Subtitles
fields.note: Track name; the delivery clause (native · burned · overlay) is a note under the same label.

fields.label: Source read
fields.note: Measured source read activity only. Configured input pacing is not a measurement; unsupported clients show Unavailable.

fields.label: Ready on server
fields.note: Contiguous complete media beginning at the latest accepted absolute playhead or seek anchor. Missing is 0.0 s; unobservable or evicted coverage is Unavailable.

fields.label: Ready state
fields.note: Ready · Missing · Unavailable; kept separate so unknown is never rendered as zero.

fields.label: Later ready
fields.note: A later contiguous ready island is diagnostic context, never runway at the current playhead.

fields.label: HTTP wait
fields.note: Active server-side media responses waiting for publication. This does not describe client buffering.

fields.label: Buffered on device
fields.note: Contiguous native/browser loaded media ahead of the attached current playhead. Prepared successors never contribute.

fields.label: Presentation
fields.note: The player's observed presentation state; it does not infer a server or network cause.

fields.label: Last advance
fields.note: Age of the last observed film-clock or frame advance. Unavailable until an advance has been observed.

fields.label: Server response rate
fields.note: Server-reported completed-response rate; "· idle" appended when delivery has gone quiet. Completion is not proof of receipt or decode.

fields.label: Server responses completed
fields.note: Server-reported completed response bytes for this session. Never labelled Transferred.

fields.label: Status sample age
fields.note: Age since this client received the currently displayed server sample.

fields.label: Observed download rate
fields.note: The player's own throughput estimate.

fields.label: Stream rate
fields.note: The declared rate of the rendition being played.

fields.label: Transferred
fields.note: Client access-log bytes — a different number from Delivered, so a different label.

fields.label: Started in
fields.note: Time to first frame.

fields.label: Server state
fields.note: One vocabulary: No server-side session · Active · Holding buffer · Served from cache (+ the VOD states on the web). Debug shows it too.

fields.label: Encode speed
fields.note: "(avg)" appended when only the cumulative figure exists. Never abbreviated to Encode.

fields.label: Production actual
fields.note: Actor-owned media produced beyond accepted client demand. This is producer control, not a client or server-ready buffer.

fields.label: Production target
fields.note: Actor-owned pacing target. Advisory policy is never relabelled as measured buffer.

fields.label: Fetch reserve
fields.note: Compatibility frontier measured beyond the last fetched segment, not beyond the playhead.

fields.label: Control
fields.note: Playback-control session owner and state; timing and failure are notes under the same label in Debug.

fields.label: Surface
fields.note: What is drawn over the picture right now — none · indicator · banner · blocking.

fields.label: Fault
fields.note: The fault class the surface is projecting: preparing · buffering · recovering · hold · degraded · refused · exhausted · stopped.

fields.label: Source
fields.note: The raw event the fault came from, as named in tests/playback/playback-surface-contract.json.

fields.label: Attached/intent
fields.note: The media generation the fault is about and the viewer request it belongs to, if any.

fields.label: History
fields.note: Last 16 faults: class · source · raised → cleared (by) · player at raise (rate, position, presenting, stopped_by_owner).

fields.label: Frames at the switch
fields.note: Dropped frames counted over the two seconds either side of a prepared commit, with how much of that window the samples cover. An observation, never a verdict: the bar it is measured against lives in docs/playback-control/QUALITY-SWITCH-CONTINUITY-RESULTS.md.

fields.label: Audio at the switch
fields.note: Audio discontinuity over the same window — Apple access-log stalls, Android audio-sink underruns, and on the web the reason the analyser probe is deliberately not on the audible path.

fields.label: Tap to new quality
fields.note: Wall time from the viewer's tap to the successor's first frame. Reported, never judged.
